g.text: Comprehensive Functional Decomposition across Presentation, Core Microservices, NoSQL Database, and EVM Ledger
✔ QR Code Authenticity Scanner upon Delivery
✔ Review & Verify Donor Account on Blockchain
✔ Match & Issue Units + Real-Time Analytics Dashboard
• Enforces strict clinical 90-day rest period rule
• Blocks premature blood unit collection (409 Conflict)
• Automated inventory allocation for critical orders
• Masks donor PII: returns count, group, and city only
• Anti-tamper logic: compares dbHash against chainHash
• Server-side admin wallet signer (Gasless for users)

svg.text: JSON-RPC / Signed EVM Tx (Proof Hashes Only)

g.text: Strict Rule: Zero PII on Blockchain
• Storage Shelf Location & Base64 QR URL
Protected personal data is stored strictly in MongoDB and never touches the public chain.
Hospitals and recipients verify blood units via standard view calls with no gas fees or wallets.
Unauthorized database alterations immediately fail the on-chain Keccak-256 hash match.
